question: Why is withholding sacrifice-given enjoyments called theft?
premises: gods nourished by sacrifice give desired objects
not returning those gifts is theft
withholding given objects for enjoyment makes one a thief
inference: one must use enjoyments as they arise because withholding sacrifice-given gifts is theft
uncertainties: fused sandhi tokens are glossed as wholes
plain_english: Gods nourished by sacrifice give desired objects; one who enjoys them without returning is a thief, so enjoyments should be used as they arise.
